---
title: "Income Support Caseload Analysis"
format: html
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# Load the data
data <- read_csv("../../is-aggregated-data-april-2005-sep-2025.csv")

# Preprocess the data
data <- data %>%
  mutate(Date = ymd(Date))
```

## Historic Trend of Income Support Caseload

```{r trend}
# Aggregate caseload over time
trend_data <- data %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  summarise(TotalCaseload = sum(Caseload, na.rm = TRUE))

# Plot the trend
ggplot(trend_data, aes(x = Date, y = TotalCaseload)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Historic Trend of Income Support Caseload",
       x = "Date",
       y = "Total Caseload")
```

## Breakdown by BFE and ETW

```{r breakdown}
# Aggregate caseload by BFE and ETW
breakdown_data <- data %>%
  group_by(Date, Category) %>%
  summarise(TotalCaseload = sum(Caseload, na.rm = TRUE))

# Plot the breakdown
ggplot(breakdown_data, aes(x = Date, y = TotalCaseload, color = Category)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Caseload Breakdown by BFE and ETW",
       x = "Date",
       y = "Total Caseload",
       color = "Category")
```

## Conclusion

The analysis highlights the overall trend in Income Support caseload and provides insights into how the breakdown by BFE and ETW categories changes the narrative.
